targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  created_at AS time,
  run_id,
  question_id AS "Question ID",
  LEFT(question, 80) AS "Question",
  ROUND(current_ts::numeric, 1) AS "Playhead (s)",
  ROUND(latency_ms::numeric, 0) AS "Latency (ms)",
  cache_source AS "Cache",
  model_tier AS "Tier",
  LEFT(answer, 200) AS "Answer",
  status
FROM bench_ask_result
WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  question_id AS "Question ID",
  LEFT(question, 100) AS "Question",
  ROUND(current_ts::numeric, 1) AS "Playhead",
  ROUND(latency_ms::numeric, 0) AS "Latency ms",
  cache_source AS "Cache",
  model_name AS "Model",
  LEFT(answer, 240) AS "Answer"
FROM bench_ask_result
WHERE run_id = (
  SELECT run_id FROM bench_ask_result ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY question_id;

panels.title: Bench client latency by cache_source (last hour)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  cache_source AS "Cache",
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)::numeric, 0) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)::numeric, 0) AS p50_ms,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)::numeric, 0) AS p95_ms
FROM bench_ask_result
WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
  AND status = 'ok'
  AND latency_ms >= 0
GROUP BY cache_source
ORDER BY cache_source;

SELECT cache_source AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM bench_ask_result
WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
GROUP BY cache_source;
